catalogs.completeness_basis: CU Denver Undergraduate Programs A-Z of the 2026-2027 Academic Catalog, counted as 86 programs: one per listed bachelor's entry, as records are keyed. Rural-partnership variants collapse to one program, and tracks, options and emphases collapse to their major: BFA emphases become Visual Arts BFA and Film & Television BFA, and the Music BS emphases become Music BS. Separately listed licensure-endorsement and Gardner Scholar entries count separately. Excluded: minors, certificates, microcredentials, 4+1/BA-MA/5-year combined entries and licensure pathways. Counted anyway because unsure: 2 Economics dual bachelor's degrees, and Information & Cybersecurity Management BSBA, which appears only in the page navigation. The 77 verified records cover 75 of the 86: 2 records are both Science (6-12) License BA, and Nursing BS (an Anschutz program) is not on this list. Update 2026-10-21 (Research session): the 2026-10-06 entry said 75 verified, but the 2026-10-06 consolidation of rural-partnership license variants left 72 verified records (status used 72), each on a distinct listed page. Law Studies, BA; General Business, BS in Business Administration; and the Economics BA/Mathematics, BS dual degree now have verified records (decision CO-2026-10-06-cat-ucdenver1021), so 75 of the 86 are verified. The count of 86 is unchanged.
